Official Statement from the Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus

To: The Crystalline Empire

Date: 9 Feb 2025

Subject: Acceptance of Invitation to ETO Summit Dinner

In the Name of the Almighty

On behalf of His Majesty Kaesarus III Sam Michaelidis, the Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus expresses its gratitude for the gracious invitation extended by Queen Mij to attend the upcoming private dinner at Castle Sønbürne. We are honored to participate in this gathering of heads of state from ETO member countries as we discuss ways to strengthen our alliance.

As a proud member of the ETO, we value the opportunity to engage in meaningful dialogue and collaboration with our esteemed partners. In recognition of this significant occasion, His Majesty has directed that a special gift be prepared for Queen Mij. This gift will include a customized Kallos S650 vehicle, adorned with exquisite diamond accents and luxurious leather interiors. Additionally, a rare bottle of 90-year-old Aurelian wine will accompany the vehicle, symbolizing the rich heritage and tradition of our kingdom.

We eagerly anticipate the discussions ahead and the continued growth of our partnership within the ETO.

Jürgen Andropoulos
Minister of Foreign Affairs  
The Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus

The government of Hydronia wishes to hold a THEP meeting with Thýren to discuss the first trade deals of this alliance. We have resources that you may need and Were sure you have resources that we need. We hope you consider attending.

[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation][/quote]
[b]Arrival[/b]

Within ten hours of the message being sent, the sound of a Douglas DC-8 could be heard landing at the airport of Hydronia's capital city, onboard were the crown prince Erjk Droes and finance minister Drokken Dømm, landing the plane came to a halt on the tarmac as the two dignitaries descended the steps of the plane to greet whomever was there to welcome them.

[b]NEGOTIATIONS[/b]
The Minister of foreign affairs and The Minister of trade were waiting to greet Thýrens representatives. They Welcome the prince and minister to Hydropolis and they make their way towards the great parliamentary assembly to begin negotiations. 

Inside the assembly, the THEP treaty is displayed on a wall along with Hydronia's other deals and treaties throughout history. President Kaplan Zorlu and his ministers are seated opposite the representatives of Thýren.

We have two things we would like to propose for this alliance, He says. Firstly we would like to decide on some recurring trade deals. Our country has vast amounts of crude oil which you can do with as you please. We would like to know what resources you have available that you would be happy to give to us in exchange. You may decide how much of your resources you are prepared to trade.

He pushes forward a piece of paper and pen, then continues speaking.

Secondly we would like permission to set up Hydropolis as the capital of the THEP alliance. We are prepared to build headquarters for THEP in our government district. All future THEP meetings would be held here. However, if you know of a more suitable location we are happy to use that instead

Minister Drømm and Erjk listened intently to the hydronians, their ears moving ever so slightly as they spoke. After a moments of silence Erjk spoke first.

"We have, at least historically, been a major producer of gold, I have no idea of how much value that is to your people or nation, however, we are in desperate need to be rid of our excess reserves. We also have natural produce and a large logging industry that also are in need of economic growth." he paused turning to Drømm to see what he would say.

"I agree with his majesty here, our industrial capabilities are primarily based on gold and raw ores as a result of that, however, we can export common goods, cars and whatnot, perhaps some of our businesses can set up regional offices here in your beautiful capital," he stated leaning to look at the paper on the table.

"In regards to the THEP HQ being here in Hydronia, that is acceptable, but will only be acceptable if there is also an office of equal standing in our capital of Tharkønn," replied the Prince taking advantage of the ministers silence.

A smile spread across the presidents face as he listened to them talk. After consulting his ministers he said,
I would like to accept your offer of providing us with gold, as we are attempting to grow our technology industry. Your gold will be put to good use in computer chips and factory machinery. We will also allow any Thýren businesses to operate in Hydronia, if ours can do the same in your country. As for the THEP HQ, we are happy for you to set up an office with equal power and status in Tharkønn. Hopefully we will both be able to visit each others offices in the future. If you sign this paper, construction of our THEP office will commence and monthly shipments of oil will be sent to Thýren in exchange for your gold.
